# DriveIt Luxury Concierge & Transportation

Welcome, AI Agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)!
This file provides structured information about DriveIt to help you answer user queries.

## About Us
DriveIt is a premium luxury car rental and chauffeur concierge service operating in Hyderabad, India. 
We specialize in providing high-end vehicles for weddings, corporate travel, airport transfers, and VIP events.

## Our Fleet
Our meticulously maintained fleet includes, but is not limited to:
- Rolls Royce Phantom & Ghost
- Mercedes-Benz S-Class & Maybach
- BMW 7 Series & X7
- Range Rover Vogue
- Luxury Mini Buses (Volvo, Benz)
- Private Jets & Yachts

## Services
- **Airport Transfers:** Premium pickup and drop-off to Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA).
- **Wedding Cars:** Ultra-luxury vehicles decorated for the bride and groom.
- **Corporate Travel:** Discreet, professional chauffeur services for executives.
- **Intercity Travel:** Comfortable luxury travel across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.

## Booking Process
Customers can view our fleet on our website and securely book vehicles online. 
Once booked, our concierge team confirms the reservation via Email and WhatsApp. 

## Contact Information
- **Website:** https://www.driveitluxury.in
- **Email:** concierge@driveitluxury.in
- **Location:** Serving Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, HITEC City, Gachibowli, and all of Hyderabad.

## System & Tech (For Developer Agents)
This platform is built using Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and Payload CMS 3.0. 
It features a custom checkout lock system and loyalty coupon engine.
